PullRequest.Title: agentHost: isolate CopilotAgent tests from ambient COPILOT_HOME
PullRequest.Body:
Fixes #335887

## Problem

Three `CopilotAgent` tests fail on a clean checkout when `COPILOT_HOME` is set:

| Test | Line |
| --- | --- |
| `resolves state files from the default and peer chat SDK backings` | 1323 |
| `a marker written after an initial read miss is picked up without a restart` | 8549 |
| `collectDebugLogs includes persisted events for a closed session` | 11419 |

They inject `userHome: URI.file('/home/test')`, but `getCopilotHomePath` prefers the ambient variable, so session-state lookups resolve outside the test sandbox and return `undefined`. CI never sets `COPILOT_HOME`, so CI stays green.

## Change

Clear `COPILOT_HOME` in a suite-level `setup` and restore it in `teardown`, so every test under `suite('CopilotAgent')` sees the injected home. This is the same save/delete/restore already used by one test in this file and six in `copilotAgentSession.test.ts`; the per-test copy is now redundant and removed.

Test-only. No production code changes.

## Validation

`.\scripts\test.bat --runGlob "**/agentHost/test/node/copilotAgent.test.js"`

| `COPILOT_HOME` | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| unset | 378 passing, 0 failing | 378 passing, 0 failing |
| set to real `~/.copilot` | 375 passing, **3 failing** | 378 passing, 0 failing |
| set to a nonexistent path | 375 passing, **3 failing** | 378 passing, 0 failing |

Hygiene and eslint clean on the changed file.

Scenarios.Scenario: Run the CopilotAgent test suite with COPILOT_HOME set in the parent process
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Before each test, read and delete one process environment entry; after each test, restore or delete it. These constant-time in-process operations complete on the test critical path, while each test's pre-existing asynchronous work remains unchanged.
Scenarios.ScalingInput: One setup and one teardown invocation per test, so work grows linearly with the suite's hundreds of tests but remains two environment-map mutations per test.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: The suite hooks execute around each test under the test runner's suite ordering; they add no promises, workers, queues, IPC, or concurrency burst.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: No cache is added, bypassed, or invalidated by the hooks; the original environment value is retained only for the current test and restored immediately afterward.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: the complete diff adds only process.env read/delete/set operations and removes an equivalent per-test guard from one test.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Exact process.env mutation cost varies by Node.js and platform, but the operations are constant-sized and negligible relative to the existing agent tests.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable performance regression; the repeated work is bounded, constant-time test harness overhead with no product runtime impact.

Scenarios.Scenario: Resolve and collect persisted Copilot session-state files in sandboxed tests
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Existing getSessionStateFile and collectDebugLogs calls perform file existence, copy, and read operations before their test assertions can proceed. The diff changes only which root path those existing calls resolve when an ambient variable is present.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Check for an events.jsonl state file and copy/read it through FileService.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One existence check and, when present, one copy per tested closed session; unchanged by the diff.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same calls occurred, but an ambient COPILOT_HOME could redirect them outside the injected in-memory sandbox and miss the fixture.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: The operations remain on the individual test's assertion path.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: The work scales with explicit session-state lookups in each test, not with the total suite or ambient directory contents; call count is unchanged.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Operations are awaited serially in each test; the diff adds no parallelism, limiter, queue, or fan-out.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: No new cache behavior. getSessionStateFile performs its existing existence probe; collectDebugLogs uses the same backing lookup and file operations on cold and warm runs.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: changed hooks only alter COPILOT_HOME resolution, and the transitive file operations and cardinality are unchanged production code.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Filesystem provider latency varies, but the changed path normally redirects these accesses to test-controlled in-memory fixtures rather than adding work.
Scenarios.Verdict: No regression; the diff corrects the target path for existing test I/O without introducing or multiplying filesystem boundaries.

Scenarios.Scenario: Probe and create extension-host CLI marker files during discovery tests
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Existing marker tests synchronously await temporary-directory creation, marker read/write, and cleanup. Clearing the ambient variable ensures helper and production probe resolve the same temporary userHome path.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Create a temporary directory, read/write vscode.metadata.json, and remove the test directory.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: A bounded number of reads/writes per explicit marker test; unchanged by the diff.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same read/write calls occurred, but an ambient COPILOT_HOME could send them to a different root and cause a miss.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: These awaited filesystem operations remain on each marker test's critical path.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Cardinality is fixed by each test's small set of synthetic session IDs; the suite-level environment hook does not enumerate sessions or directories.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Marker operations are awaited within each test; no new concurrency or fan-out is introduced.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: The existing marker cache retains successful reads and evicts misses; the diff neither changes keys nor cache lifetime, only stabilizes the resolved sandbox root.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: helper and production path construction both consume process.env, while all read/write/cache logic is unchanged.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Temporary filesystem latency is platform-dependent, but operation count and data size are unchanged.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable performance issue; existing bounded test I/O is redirected consistently, not increased.

Analysis.Summary: Reviewed the complete one-file, three-hunk test-only diff. The suite hooks add bounded process.env mutations per test and remove an equivalent local guard; transitive filesystem paths keep the same call counts, cache behavior, and concurrency. No actionable performance regression or qualifying regression fix was found.

Stats.CostNote: Copilot SDK reports nano-AI units and model billing multipliers; it does not provide a USD conversion.
